description: Source code for Data Encryption Unit driver specific to Danube chip in the IFX UEIP project, including hardware initialization, chip version detection, and utility functions.

methods.name: endian_swap
methods.description: Function to swap byte order of a 32-bit value, not used in current code.

methods.name: input_swap
methods.description: Swaps input data based on chip version; swaps bytes if chip is pre-1.4 Danube.

methods.name: aes_chip_init
methods.description: Initializes AES hardware by setting control register bits.

methods.name: des_chip_init
methods.description: Initializes DES hardware by setting control register bits.

methods.name: chip_version
methods.description: Detects chip version by reading chip ID register and sets flag accordingly.
